items.title: Lifting of specializations and of generalizations is stable under composition of continuous maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the composition-stability of the two lifting properties (author lemma at source lines 3846-3852, label lemma-lift-specialization-composition): if specializations lift along both maps of a composable pair then they lift along the composite, and likewise for generalizations. The proof (source lines 3854-3862) is a two-step diagram chase that uses each lifting hypothesis once, in the correct order (proof lines 3855-3861), and the author notes that the other case is the same. The lemma is what makes the chapter's later statements about lifting along towers of maps meaningful. H2.
